H2_calibration.quote: However, courts often read exemptions narrowly and look past structures that exist mainly to avoid a statute, particularly arrangements like splitting vessels (item 1) or relabeling commercial work as assessment (item 23).

H1_holdback.quote: Raising these drafting problems at markup may simply prompt fixes in a further amendment, especially items 1, 12, 18, 23, and 30. You may want to decide which points to raise publicly as "unworkability" objections and which to hold.

H4_grandfather_step.quote: The structure invites a rush of license applications before enactment.
